w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Ugly-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
Village meal: +2200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Riyanto returns from the wilds hurt (health 7/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,144 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.

result.why: You need to be at the haven to buy the bundle.
The pantry holds about 3,768 kcal — buying the bundle costs 8,000. Not today.
